compiled_state.title: ci.yml: DSO_LLM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES variable documented but llm-review job uses hardcoded timeout-minutes: 10
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Finding 2 from review of provision-ruleset.sh / ci-dso-staged.yml. The DSO_LLM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES env variable is documented but the llm-review job uses a hardcoded timeout-minutes: 10 rather than reading from the variable. This creates a documentation/implementation mismatch.

comments.body: Investigation: DSO_LLM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES is not documented or implemented anywhere in the current codebase. The referenced ci-dso-staged.yml no longer exists. The llm-review job in ci.yml uses timeout-minutes: 10 which is the correct configured value. GitHub Actions does not support dynamic timeout-minutes from env variables. No code change needed.
